archive_layout: project files at archive root for direct overlay extraction
migration_revision_fix: 0020_overture_feed (18 characters), within PostgreSQL default alembic_version.version_num VARCHAR(32)

automatic_approval.default_safety_note: Automatic provider/branch publication remains disabled by default and is blocked at the final write boundary unless explicitly enabled.
automatic_approval.approval_source_of_truth: Overture Places; Companies House and official funeral-director websites are optional corroboration and material-conflict signals, not approval prerequisites.
automatic_approval.company_link_requirement: A reviewer-verified link is required only to use a Companies House record as a conflict signal; direct Overture-first publication does not require a Companies House link.

overture_pipeline.ingestion_adapter: Scheduled daily STAC release detection; DuckDB queries public Places GeoParquet for England in place
overture_pipeline.admin_csv_upload: Retired: caller-supplied candidate payload imports return HTTP 410. Initial candidates are ingested only from the official Overture Places STAC/GeoParquet feed; reviewer-authenticated feed-check and processing controls remain.
overture_pipeline.geography_scope: England; broad bbox followed by official ONS county/unitary authority point-in-polygon validation
overture_pipeline.new_release_only: yes; daily STAC checks do not rescan an unchanged release
overture_pipeline.task_recovery: Persists Celery task ID, resumes unfinished scheduled import run on redelivery, batch progress metadata and structured logs
overture_pipeline.candidate_processing_query_fix: Apply run_id filter before order_by/limit; regression test added.
overture_pipeline.boundary_cache: Persistent named Docker volume; source, retrieval timestamp, schema version and SHA-256 validated; 30-day TTL
overture_pipeline.website_leads: Original Overture URL retained separately; search alternatives are filtered, individually recorded with source/query/status and body-free structured identity evidence; mismatches are never promoted.
overture_pipeline.enrichment_retries: Initial assessment plus at most three scheduled retries after 2, 7 and 21 days; excludes exceptions and exclusions
overture_pipeline.stale_run_recovery: Daily recovery after 24 hours: release stale candidate claims, resume pending work, close empty orphaned runs with audit events; never deletes history
overture_pipeline.publication_fields: Provider and branch name/address/postcode/coordinates come from normalized Overture fields; corroborating sources do not silently replace them.

tests.python_compileall: GitHub Actions run #166 passed Python compileall for application and migrations.
tests.targeted_pytest: Run #166 full API suite passed 179 tests, including Stage 3 evidence, Stage 4 route authentication, Stage 5 archive reproducibility/exclusion and migration revision tests.
tests.full_api_pytest: GitHub Actions run #166 passed 179 API tests (one existing deprecation warning), Python compile, frontend lint, TypeScript and production build.
tests.frontend_build: GitHub Actions run #166 passed the frontend production build, including reviewer-token sign-in.
tests.docker_build: GitHub Actions run #166 passed isolated Docker image build and integration.
tests.isolated_docker_integration: GitHub Actions run #166 passed disposable Docker integration; migration 0023 was downgraded to 0022 and upgraded back to 0023, after which all five evidence tables and providers.business_form were verified. Reviewer credential forwarding, disabled approval/feed/processing/scheduling, API readiness/version, admin HTTP 200, idle worker and empty Beat schedule also passed.

approval_policy.shared_policy_version: shared-provider approval policy is not authoritative for the Overture adapter
approval_policy.provider_adapter_ruleset: provider-auto-approval-v1.2 (legacy non-Overture pathway; independent initial discovery is retired)
overture_required_gates: stable GERS identity and Overture source/release/contributor provenance
complete structured Overture street/locality and valid UK postcode
overture_material_conflicts: dissolved or legal-identity contradiction from an explicitly reviewer-verified Overture-to-Companies House link
explicit closed-branch evidence from a reachable, robots-permitted official provider website
different structured branch postcode from a reachable, robots-permitted official provider website only when street and locality identify the same Overture branch
not_overture_approval_gates: official provider website presence or reachability
robots.txt permission as a prerequisite when no website evidence is available
approval_policy.provider_and_companies_house_geography: fail closed until the point in England is explicitly confirmed
approval_policy.overture_geography: official ONS England point-in-polygon confirmation; missing or unavailable geometry fails closed
approval_policy.note: Overture confidence is not a probability or proof of identity. Missing secondary corroboration alone is not a conflict or reason to block an otherwise valid Overture record.

website_evidence.source_provenance: Each attempted URL records discovery source and search query where applicable.
website_evidence.identity_evidence: Persist only selected structured identity fields, page title, response status and SHA-256 digest; page bodies are discarded.
website_evidence.third_party_filtering: Expanded exclusions for social networks, public registers, news, notices, directories, job pages and document URLs.
website_evidence.approval_policy: No approval thresholds or publication gates relaxed; automatic approval remains disabled by default.

identity_provenance.source_policy: Overture Places official feed is the sole initial discovery source; caller-supplied candidate imports and independent discovery sources are disabled. Companies House and provider-owned websites are supporting identity and branch evidence only.
identity_provenance.verification: Reviewer-authenticated, explicit Overture-to-Companies House links with structured evidence; pending links are ineligible for identity assessment.
identity_provenance.reviewer_authentication: Identity-review credentials are configured as reviewer IDs mapped to SHA-256 token hashes; administrative read and mutation endpoints require bearer authentication.
identity_provenance.direct_creation: Direct provider and branch creation endpoints return 410; direct provider publication is rejected. Active publication is restricted to the Overture worker.
identity_provenance.legacy_discovery: Independent Google Places, Companies House and company-website discovery entry points and legacy worker tasks are disabled.
identity_provenance.public_endpoint: /api/v1/directory/search remains public; internal directory and candidate/admin endpoints require reviewer authentication.

stage1_status: Core Overture-only discovery, GERS/provenance, reviewer-authenticated Companies House links, retired bypass paths and Overture-first approval safeguards are implemented. Reviewer auth and audit attribution tests passed in run #166 (179 API tests and disposable Docker integration). Formal source-rights and product/operational acceptance remain outstanding; no live processing/publication.
stage5_status: Run #166 passed 179 API tests, frontend lint/type/build, initial deterministic package generation/upload and disposable PostgreSQL 0023 downgrade/forward-upgrade. Manual inspection found stage1_api_patch.py and stage1_task_patch.py in the initial ZIP. The packager now excludes both and tests this explicitly; the corrected archive and CI artifact are pending validation. Target-host backup/replacement checklist and release sign-off remain outstanding.

security_review.access_control: Bearer reviewer authentication required for active administrative reads and mutations; public directory search and health endpoints remain intentionally public; disabled/retired endpoints return HTTP 410.
reviewed_gaps_fixed: POST /api/v1/observations now requires a reviewer and uses authenticated reviewer identity as audit actor.
Provider edits, provider status changes and observation decisions now attribute audit events to the authenticated reviewer instead of the legacy local-admin default.
defence_in_depth: GET /api/v1/enrichment/sources and GET /api/v1/enrichment/checks now have reviewer dependencies. Their enrichment router is not currently mounted in app.main, so these paths are not active API routes.
security_review.regression_tests: Run #166 passed 179 API tests including the reviewer route-introspection matrix, valid/invalid/revoked token, public-route, evidence-domain, package exclusion/reproducibility and migration revision tests.

stage2_status: Overture-first ruleset v2.0 and synthetic approval/conflict regression coverage passed run #166. Conflict detection uses verified Companies House links and branch-aligned first-party website evidence. Non-mutating live-candidate outcome analysis and product acceptance remain outstanding; no live processing/publication.
stage3_status: Separate pricing, membership and regulatory evidence, provenance, provider/branch scope, sole-trader/partnership representation, reviewer-only decisions and bounded idempotent manual revalidation passed run #166. Migration 0023 passed disposable downgrade/forward-upgrade rehearsal. Automated source-specific retrieval/refresh, source policy/legal sign-off, canonical pricing taxonomy and complete automated freshness/exception path remain open.
stage4_status: Partially implemented. Every internal API route except public directory search is reviewer-protected; route-introspection, anonymous read/write, valid/invalid/revoked token and public-route tests passed run #166. Admin frontend uses an in-memory reviewer token, audit attribution is tested and credential rotation/revocation guidance is documented. RBAC, target-environment secret rotation, backup/restore, observability/alerts and retention remain open.

release_packaging.deterministic: Fixed ZIP timestamps, sorted member order and stable file modes; repeated-build SHA-256 equality is covered by tests.
release_packaging.checks: Required-file validation, VERSION/release-manifest consistency, duplicate-path rejection, ZIP integrity validation and explicit exclusion checks.
release_packaging.ci_artifact: GitHub Actions uploads the archive, SHA-256 sidecar and package manifest with 14-day retention.
release_packaging.current_status: Initial packaging run #166 passed tests and uploaded an artifact, but manual inspection found development patch helper files in that initial ZIP. Explicit exclusions and regression tests for stage1_api_patch.py and stage1_task_patch.py are now committed; the corrected archive is awaiting a fresh CI run. Do not distribute the initial artifact.
